notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): MSUI's GameTextLaw/GameText/FontObjectLaw transcribe the same byte-verified 1.12 text laws Benilla derived: raster size clamp(round(h/768*deviceH),2,32), per-glyph floor(advance)+1 tracking (+1 more for THICK outline, baked per instance), line pitch = em with zero spacing, named FrameXML font objects with face/height/color/shadow/outline, DPI-aware atlas bake, and chat word-wrap to the message width. Both accept the same stb/FreeType hinting divergence.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The metric core - the part that made reference text measurably wider/denser and drove the 23-29% width bug - is fully ported; what is missing is the markup/link layer, which matters most for chat and tooltips fed by live server strings.
